THIRD TERM JSS1 BASIC SCIENCE  EXAMINATION QUESTIONS - EDUDELIGHT.COM
CLASS:  J.S.S1
SUBJECT: BASIC SCIENCE
1.            Fats are made up of hydrogen oxygen and ___________ a. nitrogen b. carbon c.  Iron   d fluorine
2.            ____________is the transfer of genes from parents to offspring’s a. gland b. change c. diet d. heredity
3.            Hygiene also means _____________
4.            Which of the following is not a pollutant a. smoke b. oxygen c. Carbon IV oxide d. noise?
5.            One of these insects is nocturnal a. mosquito b. grasshopper   c. butterfly d. noise
6.            The following are wildlife animals except ___________ a. goat b. tiger c. cheetah d. zebra.
7.            The accidental or deliberate discharge of oil into the environment is known as _________ a. flooding   d. erosion c. oil spillage d. oil waste
8.            Which of these vectors is responsible for sleeping sickness? A. mosquito b. tsetse fly c. blackfly d. house fly.
9.            Nigeria began small pox vaccination to children in ____________ a. 1950 b. 1960 c. 1980 d.1966
10.          There are _________ planets in the solar system. A. Three b. ten c.nine d. seven
11.          The largest plant is _________ a. Jupiter b.mars b. Saturn d. Venus
12.          The incubation period from HIV infection n to full blown AIDS is ________
a. 3 to 7 days  b. 3 to 10 years   c. 10 to 40 days  d. 2 to 5 months
13.          Cholera causes _______ a.dehydration b. shivering c. coughing b.backache
14.          The smallest planet is __________ a.saturn b. earth c.mars ed. Mercury
15.          What does the body develop after vaccination? a. another disease  antibodies  c. immunity d. antibodies
16.Forces can be all of the following except   a. contact    b. friction
c. Gravitational     d. ordinary
17. . Push, pull and tension are examples of what type of force?  a. contact force
b. magnetic force    c. gravitational force    d. electrical force
18.  The formula for calculating gravitational force is     a. GF:mxgxh
b. GF=m-gth c. Gf = m-gth       d.  GF=(m-g) x h
19.  Magndic force can be found in ____________  a. iron     b. magnet   c. rock
d. Aluminum
20.  ________is a journey to destination beyond the earth atmosphere?
a.  astronomy      b. space travel     c. transportation      d.   x& c

21.  The first human to step on moon is _______________
a. Neil Adesola     b. Neil Isaac      c.  Neil Daniel        d.  Neil Armstrong
22.  The men that travel to space are called?
a. astronauts    b.  pilot    c. sailors    d. engineers
23.  Earth is the _________planet from the sun?    a. first       b. second     c. third
d.  faith
24. Planet earth has _________moon      a.  1    b.  2     c.  4    d.    44
25.  __________is the planet that supports human existence
a. earth    b. Jupiter      c. mars       d.  Saturn
26.  How many days does it take the moon to complete its circle?
a.  24     b.  29   c.  31   d. 365
127.  Which is not a planet?   A. pluto      b.  plusto     c.  venus     d. Saturn
28.  Air in motion  is called?     a.  wind      b.  pressure     c. volume
d.  temperature
29.  The active part of air is called    a.  oxygen    b.  nitrogen     c. hydrogen
d. carbon(II)oxide
30.  Hard water causes?     A. wastage of fuel    B.  Wastage of soap
C.  Wastage of water    D.  Easy dyeing of clothes
31.  Water boils at   a. 100oc    b.  20oc      c.  35oc      d0oc
32.  Water freezes at     a.  0oc     b.100oc       c.  75oc      d.0of
33.  Which is not a use of water?
a. medium for chemical rxas     b.  cleaning and washing
c. aids digestion and absorption   d.  allof the above
34.  colloids can be found in     a. true solutions    b.  in suspensions
c.  none of the above     d. all of the above
35.  how many planets do we have?    A.  9   b.  12     c.  15    d. 35
THEORY
- (a)  Write the nine planets
(b) Define season
(c) Define climates
2.       (a)  Define force
(b)  State the types of forces you know
(c)  State three advantages of using force
(d)  Define force fields
(e)  Draw a food web
(f)   Draw a food chain
3.      State the two causes of meningitis
What time of the year is there a break-down of meningitis
SECTION C
Attempt 3 questions
1.            What is drug abuse?
a.            state five effects of drug abuse
c.             list the various personal cleanliness you must apply at home.
2a.          define growth.
b.            mention five factors affecting growth and development
c.             in a tabular form, write out the types of vitamins and their source
3.            What are disease vectors?
b.            explain the tyes of diseases
c.             discus any two factor that affect population growth
4.            Illustrate the solar system with the aid of a diagram
b.            Explain how the moon is able to provide light to the earth
BASIC SCIENCE EXAM QUESTIONS FOR JSS1 THIRD TERM
Examination malpractices may lead to a repeat of the subject or suspensions don’t be involved.
Subject: BASIC SCIENCE
Duration: 1HR  30MINS
Class: JSS 1
SECTION A: Answer all question in this section. All question carry equal mark.
- The two types of reproduction are (a) synthetic and authentic (b) sexual and bisexual (c) sexual and asexual (d) asexual and bisexual
- The following are parts of female reproductive organs except (a) breast (b) cervix (c) womb (d) vagina
- …………… is the contamination of our environment with dirty, poisonous and dangerous or hazardous substances (a) pollution (b) contamination (c) pollutants (d) home disturbance
- The following are examples of air pollutants except (a) smoke (b) sulphur dioxide (c) dust (d) water
- Which of the following can cause land pollution (a) water (b) refuse (c) dust (d) smoke
- The following are ways of controlling water pollution except………..(a) creating good drainage system (b) proper disposal of sewage (c) oil spillage should be prevented (d) Sewage should be converted fertilizers
- Cold sores all over the body is one of the sign and symptom of (a) pregnancy (b) severe headache (c) untreated toilet infection (d) HIV/AIDS
- The correct full meaning of STI is (a) spiritually terminated Identity (b) sexually trampled infection (c) sexually transmitted Induction (d) sexually transmitted infection
- Which of the following is the best way of preventing STI? (a) Public enlightenment (b) Abstinence (c) Early treatment in identified cases (d) immunization
- The following are symptoms of HIV/AIDS except (a) fever (b) frequent tiredness (c) weight loss (d) protruded stomach
- Which of the following statements is true of HIV/AIDS (a) It can be cured (b) It can be contacted by hugging (c) it is the cause of fever (d) an infected pregnant woman can transmit the virus to her baby
-  HIV/AIDS can be contacted via the following ways except…… (a) Hand shake (b) Sexual intercourse (c) Use of contaminated sharp objects (d) Transfusion of infected blood
- Gonorrhea is caused by (a) Neisseria gonorrheae (b) Chlamydia trachomas (c) syphilis (d) virus
- Pesticides and herbicides are responsible for which type of pollution (a) air (b) water (c) land (d) atmosphere
- The following are control measures of air pollution except (a) Locating industries far from human habitation (b) Educating people on the dangers of air pollution (c) keeping houses well ventilated (d) allowing bush burning
- HIV/AIDS patients can be detected facially (a) true (b) false (c) maybe (d) don’t know
- The ability to do work is referred to as (a) power (b) energy (c) work (d) food
- The following are natural sources of energy except (a)  battery (b) food ( c) sun (d) wind
- The unit of energy is (a) Joules (b) watts (c) work (d) ability
- Which of these devices can convert electrical energy to kinetic energy (a) electric bell (b) telephone (c) fan (d) motor car
- ……energy is the energy resources that can be replaced as they are used up.
- The type of pollution which effect is respiratory disorder is ……..
- Electric pressing iron can convert electrical energy to ………. energy
- The kind of energy present in the food we eat us called…….. energy
- The organ in female reproductive system which houses the baby till birth is called ………
- The bicycle dynamo converts ………..energy to light energy
- The type of reproduction human practice is ……….reproduction
- The male sex cell is called ……….
- The dirty, poisonous and dangerous or hazardous substances are called ……
- The release of poisonous gases into the  atmosphere is called…… pollution

SECTION B: Attempt any three question in this section. All question carry equal mark
- (a) What is pollution?                                                              2marks
(b) List the three types of pollution and explain any two                  5marks
(c) List three examples of sexually transmitted infections that you know  3marks

(b) Highlight three effects of water pollution                                     3marks
(c) Enumerate three cause of air pollution                               3marks
(d) Identify two control of land pollution                                2 marks

(b) List two consequences of STIs                                           2marks
(c) Define air pollution                                                             2marks
(d) State four ways of transmitting HIV/AIDS                        4marks
- (a) Define energy                                                                     2marks
(b) State the law of conservation of energy                                       2marks
(c) Mention three uses of energy                                              3marks
(d) List three land/soil pollutants                                            3marks
- (a) What are non-renewable sources of energy?                       2marks
(b) What is oil spillage?                                                                     2marks
(c) State three effect of land pollution                                               3marks
(d) State three ways of preventing HIV/AIDS                         3marks
